context: A uni student interviews a retired engineer at home
purpose: Teach: 肥満/デメリット/威力/銀河/モーター/拳/墓地/敗れ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日はお時間ありがとうございます。早速ですが、ヒロシさんが現役の頃に開発された電動モーターについて伺ってもいいですか。
lines.en: Thank you for your time today. To get right to it, may I ask about the electric motor you developed during your career?
lines.style: Polite, slightly nervous interviewer opening with measured pace and respectful tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、もちろん。あの頃はね、小型なのに威力のあるモーターを作るのが夢でね。研究室にこもって何年も要した仕事だったよ。
lines.en: Ah, of course. Back then, my dream was to build a compact motor with real power. It was work that took me years, holed up in the lab.
lines.style: Warm elderly cadence, reflective, slightly nostalgic with comfortable slow rhythm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: すごいですね。逆に、その技術のデメリットというか、苦労された点はどんなところでしたか。
lines.en: That's amazing. Conversely, what were the downsides, or the parts where you struggled?
lines.style: Engaged student tone, leaning forward, curious follow-up question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうだなあ、熱の問題でね。何度も試作で敗れて、夜中に拳を握りしめたこともあったよ。若い頃は格闘技もやってたから、負けず嫌いでね。
lines.en: Hmm, the heat issue. I lost to prototypes many times, and there were nights I clenched my fists in frustration. I did martial arts when young, so I hated losing.
lines.style: Chuckling self-deprecation, mixing pride with humility, paced storytelling.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 拳を握って、ですか。情熱が伝わります。ちなみに、開発資金は巨額だったと聞きました。
lines.en: Clenching your fists, huh. The passion comes through. By the way, I heard the development funding was enormous.
lines.style: Light laugh, impressed and genuinely moved, transitioning to practical question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん、会社が組み込まれていた国家プロジェクトでね。でも私はお金より、夜空の銀河を見上げて、いつか宇宙でも動く機械を作りたいと思っていたよ。
lines.en: Yes, it was part of a national project the company was folded into. But more than money, I'd gaze at the galaxy at night, dreaming of machines that could run in space someday.
lines.style: Soft, dreamy elder voice, looking off into the distance with quiet pride.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ロマンがありますね。最後に、退職後の今は、どんな毎日を過ごされていますか。
lines.en: That's so romantic. Lastly, how are you spending your days now in retirement?
lines.style: Warm closing tone, smiling, respectful curiosity in the final question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 妻と散歩して、月一で近所の墓地に両親の墓参りに行くくらいだね。最近は肥満が気になって、運動も始めたんだ。
lines.en: I take walks with my wife, and visit my parents' graves at the local cemetery about once a month. Lately I've been worried about getting overweight, so I started exercising too.
lines.style: Gentle, candid elder humor, relaxed and content with a self-aware smile.
